proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.free_hand
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item triggered-reaction family fits the damage-reduction mechanic, but the activation cannot currently express the explicit requirement that the wearer have a free hand when using the reaction.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 plus your Dexterity modifier if you have a free hand

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall because omitting the free-hand gate would produce a misleading trace. The catch-on-zero rider is a secondary unsupported effect and is described in the proposal.
